meta.description: Federated VKB peers. Each key is a namespace; a relation target written as the CURIE 'namespace:slug' resolves through this registry. The build is OFFLINE by default: it validates that a foreign edge's namespace is registered here (warning if not), but does not fetch products_json_url. An opt-in resolution step can later fetch a peer's products.json to confirm a target exists and enrich the edge with its title. See documentation/schema.md (Federation).
